text:
The plate looks like a side or dinner plate, roughly 22-24 cm across. On it are hash browns topped with salsa and salsa verde, plus about 3 strips of bacon.

Hash browns: about 120 g, shredded and fried, at roughly 1.5 kcal/g, so about 180 kcal.
Salsa and salsa verde: about 40 g, around 15 kcal.
Bacon: 3 strips, about 8 g each when cooked and about 12 g if thick, so roughly 30 g and 150 kcal.

Total: about 190 g and about 350 kcal.
